summary: A cleaned, enriched CSV of all ~78,000+ US FDIC-insured bank branch offices sourced directly from the FDIC BankFind Suite public API and its annual Summary of Deposits bulk export, covering institution name, full address, GPS coordinates, branch type, deposits, routing number, and 40+ fields — no auth required. Target audience is fintech companies, commercial real estate site selectors, B2B sales teams prospecting regional banks, and competitor-intelligence analysts who currently pay $250–$30,000/year to data vendors (SafeGraph, Datarade providers, Bright Data) for equivalent or inferior coverage. At $49–$79 one-time download this undercuts every commercial alternative while offering government-verified data.

audience.who: Fintech BD teams building bank partnership pipelines by asset size and state; commercial real estate brokers and site-selection consultants mapping bank density for retail leasing; insurance companies and ATM operators prospecting branch locations; municipal planners and community development orgs tracking branch deserts; data scientists and ML engineers needing labeled financial POI ground truth; journalists and researchers covering banking consolidation

data_wanted: FDIC BankFind Suite /api/locations endpoint (confirmed 78,347 records as of May 2026 index) — fields include: OFFNAME (branch name), ADDRESS, CITY, STALP (state), ZIP, COUNTY, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, CERT (institution cert number), NAME (parent bank name), ASSET, DEPSUMBR (branch deposits), SERVTYPE_DESC (branch type: full service/limited/drive-through), ESTYMD (established date), CBSA_METRO_NAME (metro area), and 25+ additional regulatory/geographic fields. No authentication required. Bulk CSV also available at https://banks.data.fdic.gov/bankfind-suite/bulkData/bulkDataDownload under 'Institutions' and 'Locations' files. NCUA credit union branch data available via CUOnline quarterly ZIP downloads at https://www.ncua.gov/analysis/credit-union-corporate-call-report-data (5,000+ federally insured CUs with branch addresses).

willingness_to_pay.signal: Multiple commercial data vendors (SafeGraph, Bright Data, LocationsCloud, ProximityOne, Acxiom) are actively selling bank branch location data derived from this same free government source at $250–$30,000/year. The market already pays for this. The DataStructured product undercuts every competitor by offering a clean, enriched, one-time download at $49–$79. Primary buyers — fintech BD teams, CRE site selectors, B2B sales prospectors — use this data to qualify bank partners, map competitor density, and build outreach lists; time-to-first-use is under 30 minutes versus 2+ weeks to get a quote from enterprise vendors.
